scientific_approval_reference: USER_DIRECTIVE_2026-09-13_PROCEED_WITH_NEXT_MOVE; approved A3+B3+C3 architecture retained; D-L adjudicated prospectively from P0-D synthetic/source evidence before real SCC25 candidate values
rank_robustness_rule: Run the same frozen pipeline independently at r=2 and r=3. Neither rank is primary. Any disagreement on a frozen material conclusion returns REPRESENTATION_DEPENDENT_NO_TRANSFER; no rank may be promoted after outcomes.
basis_rule: After the frozen transform and feature gate, center each retained gene by its mean across the six SCC25 PBS states and fit PCA/SVD using those PBS states only. Do not gene-wise variance-standardize. Project all CTX states through that already-fitted PBS basis without refitting.
normalization_rule: For every SCC25 sample independently, require every count used by the source adapter to be finite and nonnegative and require a positive finite library total. Compute library_total as the sum of all valid source gene-row counts before feature filtering, CPM = 1e6 * count / library_total, then x = log2(CPM + 1). No treatment labels, response variables, proliferation, ATAC, scRNA, Atlas coordinates, distance to unity, or downstream candidate values enter normalization. Apply the identical transform to PBS and CTX samples.
feature_universe_rule: Use the frozen GSE114446 source gene-row universe as provided. Require one nonblank unique source gene identifier per row; duplicate or missing identifiers cause refusal rather than silent aggregation. Using only the six SCC25 PBS states and the pre-log CPM values, retain a gene iff CPM >= 1 in at least 3 of 6 PBS states. CTX values are forbidden from feature selection. Freeze this same retained feature set for r=2 and r=3 and for every later refit/sensitivity in this pilot.
day0_initialization_rule: Use the measured SCC25 PBS day-0 molecular state as the single shared pre-treatment initial state for both branches. Construct five PBS transitions d0->d1->d2->d3->d4->d5 and five CTX transitions shared-d0->CTX-d1->d2->d3->d4->d5. The shared day-0 state is one measured state reused as an origin and must not be counted as two independent biological observations.
conditioning_refusal_rule: For the full fit and every leave-one-transition refit, require exact declared-design full column rank under the existing matrix-rank implementation. Separately compute a scale-normalized design condition number by dividing every nonzero design column by its Euclidean norm before SVD. Any zero-norm required predictor, nonfinite singular value, loss of full rank, or scaled condition number > 67108864 (=1/sqrt(float64 machine epsilon)) returns REFUSE_ILL_CONDITIONED_DESIGN. Passing this numerical ceiling does not by itself establish model adequacy.
model_adequacy_refusal_rule: At each A3 rank, evaluate D1 by leave-one-transition-out prediction across all 10 transitions. Define aggregate NRMSE = sqrt(sum(||y-pred||^2)/sum(||y||^2)). Compare D1 prospectively against (a) persistence pred=x_now and (b) an arm-specific leave-one-out mean-next-state baseline estimated from the remaining transitions of the omitted transition's arm. D1 is adequate only if every D1 LOTO refit passes rank/conditioning and D1 aggregate NRMSE is lower than BOTH baseline NRMSE values by more than 32*float64_epsilon*max(1,abs(baseline_NRMSE)) at BOTH r=2 and r=3. Otherwise refuse model adequacy; rank disagreement returns REPRESENTATION_DEPENDENT_NO_TRANSFER.
d2_escalation_rule: D2 may be interpreted only after D1 is adequate at both A3 ranks. At each rank every D2 LOTO refit must pass rank/conditioning; D2 aggregate LOTO NRMSE must be lower than D1 by more than the same 32*float64_epsilon comparison tolerance; and D2 must have lower per-transition relative prediction error than D1 on at least 6 of 10 omitted transitions. All criteria must hold at BOTH r=2 and r=3. Otherwise D2 status is NOT_EARNED, or INDETERMINATE/REPRESENTATION_DEPENDENT_NO_TRANSFER if admissibility differs across ranks. No distance-to-unity information may enter escalation.
uncertainty_rule: Do not use an iid bootstrap over days and do not report serial refits as biological-replicate confidence intervals. The prespecified model-conditional sensitivity envelope consists of: all admissible leave-one-transition refits; one shared-origin block refit omitting BOTH d0->d1 transitions together; and six leave-one-PBS-state basis refits in which the frozen feature set is retained, the PBS PCA basis is refit on the remaining five PBS states, and all states are reprojected before refitting the declared model. Report point estimates plus the full envelope. If a mathematical unit-circle side changes anywhere in the admissible envelope, return INDETERMINATE and REFUSE_UNCERTAINTY_SPANS_BOUNDARY.
transport_rule: The GSE114446 operator is a source-native one-day transition operator. Do not exponentiate, take matrix/spectral roots, or convert rho between daily and weekly intervals. The later GSE98812 chronic source must receive its own frozen weekly execution. Cross-timescale comparison is initially limited to source-native categorical findings: model adequate/refused, mathematical unit-circle side BELOW/ABOVE/INDETERMINATE, D2 escalation EARNED/NOT_EARNED/INDETERMINATE, and non-normal warning disposition. Numerical daily-weekly transport requires a separately earned semigroup/time-homogeneity validation.
material_conclusion_schema: A3 material conclusions are prospectively fixed as: (1) D1 adequacy PASS/REFUSE; (2) D1 mathematical unit-circle side BELOW/ABOVE/INDETERMINATE after the full sensitivity envelope; (3) non-normal warning PRESENT/ABSENT/INDETERMINATE; (4) D2 escalation EARNED/NOT_EARNED/INDETERMINATE. If D2 is EARNED at both ranks, additionally require agreement on (5) sign of rho(T_CTX)-rho(T_PBS) as POSITIVE/NEGATIVE/ZERO_WITHIN_NUMERICAL_TOLERANCE and (6) control and treated mathematical unit-circle side categories. Any r=2 versus r=3 disagreement on a material conclusion returns REPRESENTATION_DEPENDENT_NO_TRANSFER. All unit-circle language is mathematical only and does not admit a biological unity boundary.
mathematical_side_rule: For any reported operator, BELOW requires rho<1 for the point fit and every admissible sensitivity refit; ABOVE requires rho>1 for the point fit and every admissible sensitivity refit; otherwise return INDETERMINATE. Equality to 1 within 32*float64_epsilon*max(1,abs(rho)) is treated as boundary-touching and therefore INDETERMINATE.
non_normal_warning_rule: Use the existing asymptotic/transient diagnostic convention. A sensitivity-level warning is PRESENT only when the frozen non-normal warning is present throughout the admissible envelope, ABSENT only when absent throughout, and INDETERMINATE when the warning disposition changes across admissible refits.
